$comment: TRANSCRIBED from plugins/json_source/json_source_keys.h + _io.h. json_source is a generic injector whose EMITTED data plane is an OPEN schema by design (docs/new_gen/02), and whose control surface is deliberately string-shaped: the Config splices RAW user JSON under "data" ("raw_json": true + "default"), set_data carries arbitrary JSON (a raw_json command param), and the per-emit Patch shape ({key,value} single or {patches:[...]} batch) is the fixed "patch_builder" family — all constrained whitelisted shapes the generator emits verbatim since the polaris2 codegen gap #2 extension (no more "handwritten_io"). The patch key names ride "inputs" ONLY so collect_keys mints their k-constants (a source's inputs never become schema slots or TS/Py types). (The wave-2 bilingual pack_mode knob was removed at v12 — the sealed xi.pack@1 pack is the sole emit currency.)
title: json_source — user-authored JSON injector (open output; typed control surface).

config.doc: string — the user's JSON document, spliced raw under "data"

list.name: set_data
list.doc: Replace the stored JSON. Payload is arbitrary JSON text.

inputs.doc: array of {key,value} — per-emit patches (open value; generated Patch builder)

patch_builder.doc: The process input mutates the stored JSON for THIS emit only. Values are open JSON text.

output_frame.doc: int (emit counter; pack-mode entry, mirrors mock_camera). The user document's own fields ride as open, dynamically-keyed pack entries — not declared slots (open output by design).
